profile.name: Jaru Iori N. Jardeleza
profile.headline: Learning in public. Building with purpose.
profile.intro: I build practical systems across cloud infrastructure, Linux, web, mobile, and AI. Klightten is the growing library of what I learn, improve, and release.
profile.about:
I’m Jaru Iori N. Jardeleza, a BSIT student at Pateros Technological College and an aspiring cloud engineer. I learn best when an idea has to survive outside a lesson: on real hardware, with real limits, and with enough documentation that I can understand it again later.

Klightten is the identity I give to that process. It brings together my work in Linux, cloud infrastructure, web systems, mobile applications, databases, and local AI. Each project is evidence of what I understood at that point—and a starting place for the next improvement.

settings.description: The work and learning journey of Jaru Iori N. Jardeleza. Cloud, Linux, web, mobile, and AI projects.

journey.title: BSIT core knowledge
journey.description: Strengthening networking, databases, web systems, HCI, information security, and software fundamentals at PTC.

journey.title: Projects that solve real needs
journey.description: Turning lessons into Linux utilities, mobile experiences, secure web systems, databases, and tools that work on limited hardware.

journey.title: Build the Klightten Cloud foundation
journey.description: Learning to operate an always-online Linux server through SSH, system updates, firewall rules, Nginx, DNS, and HTTPS.

journey.title: Career-ready cloud experience
journey.description: Connect real deployments, databases, monitoring, automation, and documentation into a portfolio that demonstrates dependable engineering skills.

journey.title: Build Klightten into a company
journey.description: Grow Klightten from a project name into an independent brand that creates technology, products, and useful services.

works.title: Klightten Portfolio
works.summary: A plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript portfolio with a searchable work library, four themes, and a separate local editing workspace.
works.description: My portfolio is organized as readable pages, shared styles, JavaScript modules, and one public JSON file. A separate local workspace handles project editing, profile settings, previews, and optional GitHub publishing. Only the docs folder is deployed to GitHub Pages; the editor stays outside the public website.
